Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"sql\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.metrics().errorCount());
        System.out.println(result.metrics().totalBytes());
        System.out.println(result.structure());
        System.out.println(result.structure().get(0).name());
    }
}
```
